Author: Tensho
Name: Tensho Assistant
Punchline: One window for everyday tools: items, crafting, gathering, map, collections and more.
Description:
Tensho Assistant brings everyday tools together in one window (/tensho): items and storage (bags, retainers, saddlebags, armoury chest, glamour dresser, armoire), inventory sorting rules, market listings and prices, recipes and a crafting simulator, gathering and fishing with Eorzea time windows and weather, a map that replaces the game map (quests, leves, FATEs, gathering points, vendors, aether currents, teleport costs), weather, alarms and game calendar reminders, free company submarine and airship voyages and builds, quests and rewards, collections with how to obtain each item, a gear planner (materia, try on, build sharing), duty and monster loot, Fashion Report hints, Mini Cactpot and Triple Triad helpers, character stats, macro chains and a Credits page listing every source.

Community data (Universalis, Garland Tools, FFXIV Console Games Wiki, Teamcraft bite times, PaissaDB open plots (only while its watch is on or on click), and data files hosted on GitHub: LuminaSupplemental, GatherBuddy, FFXIVGachaSpreadsheet) is requested over HTTPS only when you open or hover the matching tool or a setting asks for it, with bounded replies, and cached on disk; each source has a switch in Settings › Advanced that stops every request to it. Optional, off by default: posting Tensho alarms and currency cap alerts to a Discord webhook you enter. An item's page on the wiki or the Lodestone, and partake.gg (player events), open in your browser only on a click or a /tensho command. A gallery of community tools (data only, no code), read from this plugin's repository only on a click.

Actions that reach the game (teleport, applying a sort, a macro chain, writing crafting macros, opening Try On, sending the hunt train call to the chat channel you choose) start only when you click them; game alarms are created with /alarm on a click, or automatically only with the « game alarms » setting (off by default). No automation of crafting, dialogues or loot, no combat or PvP feature.

AI disclosure: the code and the icon were generated with an AI coding agent (Claude), directed and tested in game by the author.

Languages: English and French; German and Japanese: menu titles only.
